subject: The truth about your first 2 weeks with this app
preview_text: I just checked your progress. You've accomplished more than you think. But there's one mistake most people make at this exact point.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, you downloaded Thesis Generator. You were probably staring at a blank page, feeling that deadline panic creeping in. I know because I built this app after failing my own thesis draft three times.

Here's what you've actually accomplished in 14 days: You've moved from 'I have no idea where to start' to having a tool that can generate a thesis in 10 minutes. You've got access to auto-citations, humanized AI text that bypasses detectors, and export-ready PDFs. That's the equivalent of about 8 hours of research and writing time you've already saved yourself from. Most students quit before day 7. You didn't.

But here's the secret 90% of users miss at the 2-week mark: They don't use the 'Outline to Full Paper' feature when they're stuck. They keep trying to write from scratch. The app already knows your topic, your citations, your thesis statement. Let it build the skeleton so you can focus on making it brilliant.

Open the app right now. Click 'My Projects,' pick your most recent one, and hit 'Generate Full Outline.' See what 14 days of having this tool actually looks like on paper. P.S. The students who do this at the 2-week mark are 3x more likely to finish their paper 2 days early. Don't be the person who waits until the night before.
